title: Sebi proposes allowing portfolio managers to invest overseas, in to-be-listed securities

A novel group of portfolio managers will focus on high-net-worth individuals with reduced entry thresholds. The initiative also seeks to enhance the application of derivatives strategies for clients. Stakeholders are encouraged to provide feedback on these proposals by August 13th.

title: Kuwait raises $6 billion in three-tranche bond sale, finance ministry says

The transaction is scheduled for settlement on July 30.
